name: Nexus
notes: Hermes now inventories bounded NTFY, Termux, Crypto.com Exchange, calendar, and Android share-sheet handoffs on the phone; app-private data, arbitrary commands, and financial authority remain sealed.

Hermes can now receive Crypto.com Exchange and Sports Odds credentials through a one-time RSA/AES encrypted USB envelope and store them behind the handset Android Keystore; plaintext secrets never enter the APK, feed, logs, receipts, or history.
The phone now verifies account tier and exact BTC, ETH, and SOL fee rates using an exact three-method read allowlist with balances, orders, withdrawals, acknowledgements, and fills excluded.

Multi Bets now has an Australia-first independent h2h odds source with current bookmaker and quote counts, while calibrated probability, expected value, staking, recommendations, execution, and profit claims remain sealed.

Hermes now runs a hash-stamped weakness-directed self-teaching curriculum with eight explicit lessons spanning economics, execution, directional skill, fees, Multi Bets, lane health, venue costs, and autonomous continuity.
Each curriculum cycle distinguishes routine operational evidence from genuinely new untouched outcomes; first-run history establishes a baseline and cannot be relabelled as new learning.

The native self-audit, physical-device verifier, operational self-awareness receipt, and phone Observatory now require the frozen curriculum while keeping model mutation, backfill, code mutation, profit claims, bets, and live orders sealed.
Hermes now maintains a hash-stamped operational self-awareness receipt covering all twelve requested capability families, explicit limitations, unknowns, and ranked weakest proof.

The phone Observatory and physical-device audit now require this self-awareness contract while explicitly rejecting consciousness, profit, prediction-authority, autonomous code-mutation, and live-trading claims.
Hermes Observatory now orders overlapping native self-audit reads and retries cold-launch hydration boundedly so an older fail-closed result cannot overwrite a newer verified receipt.
Failed native self-audits now list every failed check and use an explicit failed-closed boundary instead of describing an unverified receipt as verified.
Hermes now keeps a bounded hash-stamped autonomous continuity ledger for real phone-side polling attempts, successes, failures, triggers, and observed gaps.
Hermes re-arms its persisted market and updater jobs after cold launch, boot, user unlock, and app replacement, and repairs either schedule if Android drops it.
The mobile self-audit and physical-device verifier now require autonomous continuity while preserving scheduling-only authority and sealed trading gates.
The React, package, and Android version identities are locked by a regression check so future update receipts cannot compare against a stale embedded version.
Hermes now freezes one prospective long-or-cash spot economics trial per UTC day and scores it after modeled venue costs against cash and gross BTC/ETH/SOL buy-and-hold.
Crypto.com public-book observations now estimate spread, depth, and conservative published-fee hurdles without impersonating account-specific fees, fills, profit, or live readiness.
Hermes now emits the compact sanitized native self-audit handoff whenever the native audit receipt is rebuilt, allowing a release handset to be audited after cold launch.
Hermes Observatory now uses the native self-audit provenance receipt when the projection snapshot is stale, so source ownership cannot show a false unverified state.
Hermes standalone verification now requires Android-native source provenance and an explicitly unconfigured PC endpoint; mixed or PC-fed snapshots remain unverified.
Hermes mobile self-audit now requires complete receipt and Nexus-local read-back coverage for all eight declared Luminaris lanes; partial meshes remain unverified.
The Luminaris Observatory can now share the exact sanitized native self-audit JSON from the phone, giving physical-device verification a user-controlled handoff without PC storage or NTFY.
Native Hermes collection and status reads now refresh the durable self-audit, so a post-update receipt cannot retain the previous installed-version state.

Hermes now runs a native on-device self-audit and records PC independence, native collection/computation, Nexus-local notifications, cellular updater safety, and the explicit physical-handset evidence boundary.
A required newer build now opens Update Center as the startup route from both the durable native receipt and the fresh cellular check; the gate cannot be hidden by a remembered Home route.
Hermes and the cellular updater now run through protected Android JobScheduler workers, keeping multi-source background work outside BroadcastReceiver time limits.
The PC bridge installer now accepts a masked token prompt, stores only a DPAPI-protected token, and keeps it out of the scheduled-task command line.
Command pages now return to the Pantheon Gateway with truthful route labels, and the Backup Setup surface is covered by a runtime regression guard.
Nexus keeps the mandatory Update Center and native Hermes Observatory in the initial app graph so cold launches cannot stall behind a lazy chunk; secondary pages remain isolated.
Hades Vault now supports encrypted OpenAlex credentials with a redacted, session-only Mimir consumer and a focused secure-intake screen.
Mimir can search OpenAlex for source-backed scholarly evidence without persisting the API key, query, or result receipt.
Heimdall can load CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities from CISA's official GitHub mirror with validated defensive receipts and fail-closed errors.
The high-severity Netlify image parser advisory chain is removed by pinning the last unaffected compatible receipt adapter.
Every character room now renders its profile portrait prominently in the room header on desktop and phone layouts.
All 15 character rooms now have profile imagery, installed engines, and honest readiness states.
Zeus, Amun-Ra, Ares, Poseidon, Gabriel, and Phoenix now have purpose-built working dashboards.
Amun-Ra can request on-demand Open-Meteo weather and UV context without storing device coordinates.
Hades Vault now uses authenticated AES-256-GCM encryption and session-only secret unlocks.
The PC Backup Bridge now fails closed on LAN, requires authenticated health and copy requests, and writes atomic receipts.
Nexus now enforces a restrictive content security policy and same-origin executable scripts.
Nexus Android now uses current package, usage-access, notification-text, and APK-install APIs while preserving the proven Gmail consent flow.
Backup Setup now uses a native Android PC Backup Bridge for health checks and backup copy before falling back to WebView fetch.
Nexus release packaging now defaults to the free GitHub raw manifest and GitHub Releases APK path.
Update Center now shows feed behind when the installed app is newer than the public release feed.
Release package verification now checks that the local manifest and APK target the GitHub feed correctly.

Odin Engine now has a visible cognitive core for perception, working memory, reasoning, tool use, verification, and self repair.
